notes: Godot 3 Wild Jam August 2019 3D card/hand prototype with a test level, card scenes, and original Aseprite sources for the card, character, and tileset. Unused unattributed raster assets/card_art/test.png (a 1MB 3D bunny-in-helmet render that does not match the ink-doodle card art and is not referenced by any scene or script) and its .import were omitted. Unused unattributed src/assets/uv_checker.webp (a color UV inspection grid with A1–H8 typographic labels, not referenced by any scene, script, or material, and stylistically unrelated to the ink-doodle / 1-bit art) and its .import were also omitted. No fonts, no audio, no addons, no Git LFS, no editor .tmp. icon.png is an original slate-teal frog-on-card mark (md5 a75daa9f5ba9e83ee5f20983e74d89ef), replacing the Godot 3 default robot icon (md5 0167658bc4406f0d0fe437e0197c415a).
